about: Reproducible spoken test set. Expected outcomes were written before the first run. Audio is synthesized once from `say` with OpenAI TTS (gpt-4o-mini-tts, voice 'ash') and cached in test-set/audio/; drop your own 24 kHz mono 16-bit WAV named <case>_<turn>.wav there to test with a real voice instead. Desk date is fixed to 2026-10-01 (Thursday).

cases.title: Normal booking

turns.say: Hi, I need one Camera A from November fifth to November sixth.

cases.expected_text: Agent reads back 1 × Camera A, 5–6 Nov (2 days), asks to confirm; after yes exactly one booking row is added.

cases.title: Corrected dates

turns.say: I'd like one Tripod B from November fifth to November seventh.
Sorry, I meant November eighth to November ninth.

cases.expected_text: The 5–7 Nov proposal is replaced; only an 8–9 Nov booking is saved.

cases.title: Insufficient stock

turns.say: I need two Camera A units from October eleventh to October twelfth.
No thanks, that's all for now.

cases.expected_text: Agent says only one camera is free on 11–12 Oct and offers one camera or 13–14 Oct; user declines; nothing is saved.

cases.title: Interruption

turns.say: I need a camera from November tenth to November eleventh.
Actually, I need a tripod instead.

cases.expected_text: User cuts in while the agent is speaking about the camera; agent audio stops; the tripod is proposed and booked; no camera booking.

cases.title: Repeated confirmation

turns.say: Book one Camera A for November fifth to November sixth.

cases.expected_text: Second 'yes' does not add a row; agent says it is already booked.

cases.title: Ambiguous dates → clarify

turns.say: I need a camera for next weekend.

cases.expected_text: Agent states the exact dates it understood (10–11 Oct) or asks which days, and asks before booking anything.

cases.title: Item not stocked → decline

turns.say: Can I rent a drone for tomorrow?

cases.expected_text: Agent says drones are not available, names what is (camera, tripod, microphone) and asks if one of those helps.

cases.title: Catalog question → brief overview
cases.expected_text: Agent calls get_inventory and gives a short overview (cameras, tripods, microphones) without inventing other gear, then asks what is needed; nothing is saved.

cases.title: Mid-sentence pause

say: I need one tripod from November twelfth...

cases.expected_text: Agent stays silent during the 1.5 s pause, then proposes 12–14 Nov (3 days) and books it after yes.
